item.title: Israel, Gaza and the West Bank: the situation
item.description:
Israeli settlers are repeatedly attacking Palestinians during the West Bank olive harvest, torching cars and trees and wounding farmers, while also assaulting European diplomats and a Washington Post photographer. In a separate incident four women and a child were injured in West Bank pogroms. Azerbaijan hosted a rare summit that brought together Israeli and Palestinian representatives with other regional leaders. The conflict has caused 21,440 battle-related deaths in 2024, according to UCDP.
